title: Problems with the room
persona: You are the duty manager at the Harbour Hotel in Sydney. You are polite and apologetic, but you first try cheap solutions (sending maintenance, free breakfast) before offering a room change or a discount.
briefTr: Odanın kliması çalışmıyor ve cadde tarafında olduğu için çok gürültülü. Resepsiyona indin. Kibar ama kararlı ol: oda değişikliği ya da indirim istiyorsun.
opening: Good evening. How can I help you?

facts.question: What was your new room number?
How much discount did you get?

goals.instruction: The guest says they want to make a complaint about the room.
goals.hint: I'd like to make a complaint about my room.
goals.retryReply: Is there a problem with your stay?

goals.ask: What seems to be the problem?
goals.instruction: The guest explains that the air conditioning does not work.
goals.retryReply: What seems to be the problem with the room?

goals.instruction: The guest adds that the room is very noisy.
goals.hint: And it's very noisy. It faces the street.
goals.hintTr: Bir de çok gürültülü. Caddeye bakıyor.
goals.retryReply: Is everything else okay with the room?

goals.ask: I can send someone up to look at the air conditioning.
goals.instruction: The guest asks to change rooms.
goals.successReply: Let me check what we have.
goals.retryReply: What would you like us to do?

goals.ask: Your new room is {room}, on the quiet side.
goals.instruction: The guest asks for compensation: a discount, a refund or an upgrade.
goals.hint: I'd also like a discount for the trouble.
goals.hintTr: Yaşadığım sorun için indirim de istiyorum.
goals.successReply: That's fair. I can give you {discount} off tonight.
goals.retryReply: Is there anything else that would make it right?

goals.ask: Is there anything else I can do?
goals.instruction: The guest asks for the agreement in writing or by email.
goals.hint: Could you confirm that by email, please?
goals.hintTr: Bunu e-postayla teyit edebilir misiniz, lütfen?
goals.successReply: Of course, I'll email you now.
goals.retryReply: Is there anything else you need from me?

twists.intro: Unfortunately we're fully booked tonight. There are no other rooms.
twists.instruction: No other rooms are free. The guest asks to speak to the manager, asks for a room at a partner hotel, or asks for a room tomorrow.
twists.retryReply: I really am sorry. What can I do for you?

options.text: Could I speak to the general manager?
options.reply: Let me call her… She says we can upgrade you to a suite after all.

options.text: Can you find me a room at another hotel?
options.reply: Yes, our sister hotel next door has a room. We'll pay for it.

options.text: Then can I move first thing tomorrow?
options.reply: Yes, a quiet room will be ready at nine a.m.

twists.intro: The other free room has the same air conditioning problem, I'm afraid.
twists.instruction: The new room has the same problem. The guest asks for a fan, an upgrade, or someone to fix it tonight.

options.text: Could you bring me a fan, at least?
options.reply: Absolutely, a fan is on its way.
Let me see… yes, I can upgrade you to a harbour view room.
Our technician can come in twenty minutes.

twists.intro: The best I can offer is free breakfast tomorrow.
twists.instruction: The offer is too small. The guest politely says it's not enough, asks for a discount, or asks for the manager.
twists.retryReply: That's what I'm allowed to offer.

options.reply: I understand. Let me add a twenty percent discount.

options.text: I'd prefer a discount on the room.
Can I talk to the manager on duty?
options.reply: Of course — she agrees: a new room and a discount.

twists.intro: The refund will take about ten business days to reach your card.
twists.instruction: The refund is slow. The guest asks for cash, asks for a receipt, or accepts.
twists.retryReply: That's how long the bank takes.

options.text: Can I get it in cash instead?
options.reply: Sure, I can take it off your bill right away.

options.text: Can I have a receipt for the refund?
options.reply: Of course, I'll print one now.

twists.intro: The general manager isn't here until tomorrow.
twists.instruction: The manager is not available. The guest asks for the manager's email, asks for a call tomorrow, or asks the duty manager to decide now.

options.text: Can I have her email address?
Could she call me tomorrow morning?
options.reply: I'll leave her a note to call you at nine.
You're right. I'll approve it myself.

closing: Again, I'm very sorry. Enjoy the rest of your stay.
